verdict.rationale: A public, documented YubiEnterprise 'YubiKey as a Service' REST API covers fleet delivery, inventory, and shipment management, so an agent can programmatically handle the ordering/shipping leg. The scriptable ykman CLI and python-fido2 SDK allow per-device configuration from code. However, nothing in the evidence shows API-driven assignment of keys to users or pre-registration of credentials, and the API is only verified by a page title. Missing for 10: documented API support for user assignment, credential pre-registration/enrollment, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes 404), and hands-on or independent corroboration of end-to-end agent-driven provisioning.
